title: Credentials
description: The team's website logins, API keys, SSH keys and secrets. An agent uses what is granted to it without seeing a password.
managerOnly: Only the team's owners and managers add, change and grant credentials.
noAccess: You may not see the team's credentials.
deleteMessage: Delete {name}? The agents it is granted to lose it at their next run.
emptyHint: Add a website login, an API key, an SSH key or a secret, then grant it to the agents that need it.

kindHints.web_login: Hermes fills it in the browser. The agent never sees the password.
kindHints.api_key: The key of a service, for example for an MCP server.
kindHints.ssh_key: {appName} generates the key pair and shows only the public key.
kindHints.secret: Any other named value, for example for an MCP server.
kindHints.runtime_login: Signs in the Claude Code or Codex runtime of the agents it is granted to. The agent never sees it.
kindHints.decision_model: A fast model for typed decisions: browser steps, sorting mail, model choice, receipts (Jev, the local AI or a compatible server).
kindHints.variable: A value that is not secret (an account ID, say), as an environment variable for the commands of the agents it is granted to.

name: Name
allowedDomainsHint: One per line. Hermes fills the login only on these domains and on the domain of the login URL.
totpHint: The setup key or otpauth:// link of two-factor authentication. Hermes then creates the codes itself.
secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

ssh.publicKeyHint: Add it where the agent signs in, for example as a deploy key on GitHub. The private key stays in {appName}.
ssh.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new key pair? The current public key stops working wherever it was added.
ssh.generatedOnSave: {appName} generates an ed25519 key pair when you save and then shows its public key.

hints.claude_oauth_token: Run "claude setup-token" in the terminal, confirm in the browser and paste the token shown here. It lasts a year and uses your Claude plan.
hints.claude_api_key: An API key from the Claude Console (platform.claude.com), billed by usage.
hints.codex_api_key: An API key from platform.openai.com. To use ChatGPT, sign a Codex agent in on its agent page.
hints.codex_oauth_token: Codex takes only an API key here. To use ChatGPT, sign a Codex agent in on its agent page.

logins.title: Sign-ins
logins.notReported: The runner has not reported the sign-in yet

signIn.claude: Run it in the terminal (Home → Terminal), confirm in the browser, store the token as a runtime login (Claude Code) and grant it to this agent.
signIn.codex: Run it in the terminal (Home → Terminal) and follow the link it shows with the code. Codex renews the sign-in itself afterwards.

signOutMessage.codex: Codex signs {name} out of its own sign-in. The agent works again only after you sign it in again.
signOutMessage.claude: Claude Code signs {name} out of its own sign-in. A credential granted to it stays as it is.

logins.sharedDetail: Every Hermes agent uses this sign-in

env.toggle: Give it to agents as an environment variable
env.toggleHint: The agents it is granted to get the value as a variable for their commands (wrangler, for example) in every run. {appName} masks it wherever it shows what an agent did.
env.name: Variable name
env.nameHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores, e.g. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
env.nameInvalid: Only capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or an underscore, at most 64 characters.
env.variableHint: Not secret: {appName} shows the value and does not mask it.

environment.title: Environment variables
environment.agentHint: What this agent's runs receive from Credentials as variables.
environment.noAccess: You may not see the team's credentials.
